book.title: Physik (Septimus Heap, #3)
book.description:
When Silas Heap unseals a forgotten room in the Palace, he releases the ghost of a queen who lived five hundred years earlier. Queen Etheldredda is as awful in death as she was in life, and is still up to no good. Her diabolical plan to achieve everlasting life requires the talents of her son, Marcellus Pye, a famous Alchemist and Physician. And when Jenna and Septimus become involved, then you can be sure that Darke adventure awaits.

Packed with heart-stopping action and brilliant characters, Physik continues the magical Septimus Heap series.
